description: This file contains unit tests for credential classes within the Eclipse Hono project, specifically testing encoding, decoding, and class behavior for different credential types such as password, PSK, and X509 credentials.

classes.name: CredentialsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying encoding, decoding, and class behaviors of different credential implementations in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: testEncodePasswordCredential
methods.description: Tests encoding of a PasswordCredential object to JSON, including its secrets.

methods.name: testEncodePskCredential
methods.description: Tests encoding of a PskCredential object to JSON, verifying no secrets are present.

methods.name: testEncodeX509Credential
methods.description: Tests encoding of an X509CertificateCredential object to JSON.

methods.name: testEncodeArray
methods.description: Tests encoding an array of credentials using a provider function.

methods.name: testEncodeMany
methods.description: Helper method to encode multiple credentials provided in a list, applying a transformation function.

methods.name: testDecodePasswordCredential
methods.description: Tests decoding a JSON representation into a PasswordCredential object and verifies fields.

methods.name: testEncodeDecode1
methods.description: Ensures encoding and decoding preserve credential data, including special characters and timestamps.
